Against the Commons standing-in-snow side view the mane/ruff barely changes the outline and the winter coat does not break the outline anywhere (no guard-hair tufts at the elbows, throat, thighs). Shape metric reads 'stable' vs declared 'friendly' (MISS) — the trunk box dominates.
fixes: fur cards or shells along the mane, throat, elbows and breeches so the outline breaks like a winter coat
